samples.question: The four bins start with the shown colored counters. Read the five SOW cards from left to right. Each card's black-dot count names a bin. On each card, remove all counters from that bin, then place them one at a time into the following bins to the right, wrapping from bin 4 to bin 1, until all removed counters are placed. How many counters are in the magenta-ringed bin at the end? Answer 0 through 8.
